title: Hot Today, Rainy Yesterday
text:
Today the weather is hot. The sun is shining and the sky is blue. I wear a hat and shorts. I drink cold water.

Yesterday it was rainy and windy. I stayed at home and read a book. My cat slept on the sofa.

questions.text: What is the weather like today?
Where did the writer stay yesterday?
How does the writer probably feel today?
Why did the writer probably stay at home yesterday?
options: Because it was rainy and windy

vocabulary.definition: with a lot of wind blowing
with a lot of rain falling

paragraph_translations: Hoje o tempo está quente. O sol está brilhando e o céu está azul. Eu uso um chapéu e um short. Eu bebo água gelada.
Ontem estava chuvoso e ventoso. Eu fiquei em casa e li um livro. Meu gato dormiu no sofá.
